sloka: केचित् मुकुल संवीताः श्याम वर्णा इव  आबभुः ।इदम् मृष्टम् इदम् स्वादु प्रफुल्लम् इदम् इत्यपि ॥४-१-८७॥
transliteration: kecit mukula saṁvītāḥ śyāma varṇā iva  ābabhuḥ ।idam mṛṣṭam idam svādu praphullam idam ityapi ॥4-1-87॥

translations.english: 'Fascinated by the flowers, the honeybees cling to one or the other, humming, 'this is soft, this is sweet, and this is fullyblossomed.'
